audience: small businesses and organisations who send text messages with FireText

useCases.title: Check your SMS credit and what you sent
useCases.text: The AI reads the credits left on the account or a sub-account, and the totals of campaigns, recipients and credits used for a date range.

useCases.title: Review sent and scheduled messages
useCases.text: The AI lists messages you sent in a date range with recipient counts, and the messages queued for later with their scheduled time.

useCases.title: Check delivery and link clicks of a message
useCases.text: The AI reads the delivery status per recipient of one sent message, and the link clicks if it used Trackable SMS.

useCases.title: Read incoming texts and keywords
useCases.text: The AI lists inbound SMS received on your numbers and keywords, or only the new ones since the last call, and lists your keywords.

useCases.title: Review opt-outs or opt a contact out
useCases.text: The AI lists contacts who opted out with date and reason, and can opt a contact out of your groups.

useCases.title: Add a contact or send a text
useCases.text: The AI adds or updates a contact by mobile number, or sends an SMS to up to 10 numbers. A sent SMS uses credits and cannot be undone.
